failures.expect: a good hard day: energy and carbs close to target

review.good: You were close to the target for carbohydrates with 500 of 490 g consumed.
review.short: Your salt intake was 6 g against a limit of 5 g, and sugar was 55 g against a limit of 50 g, which can impact recovery and hydration.
review.tip: For tomorrow, swap the honey on your bagel for sliced banana to reduce added sugar and help manage your salt intake after your hard ride.

failures.comment: All numbers match the data and the salt and sugar overages are correctly flagged with a specific, actionable swap. However, the review only mentions carbs being close to target and never says energy (kcal) was on target or frames the day as a good hard day, so the expected point is only partly made.

review.good: You were close to the target for carbohydrates with 380 of 375 g.
review.short: Your protein intake was low at 95 of 135 g, which is 40 g under the target needed for muscle recovery.
review.tip: For tomorrow, add a serving of lean meat or Greek yogurt to your pasta bolognese to help reach your protein goal.

all.comment: Clearly flags protein at 95 of 135 g (40 g under) and correctly notes carbs at 380 of 375 g as on target. Tip is specific and actionable, though the bolognese already contains meat, so the advice to add lean meat is less precise than it could be.

review.good: Ви спожили цукор у межах норми, 30 з 50 грамів.
review.short: Ви спожили замало вуглеводів, 210 з 490 грамів, та калорій, 1900 з 3100, що критично для відновлення після 95-хвилинного бігу.
review.tip: Завтра перед тренуванням додайте до гречки з куркою більшу порцію крупи або з'їжте додатковий тост, щоб забезпечити енергію для навантаження.

all.comment: The review clearly flags carbs at 210 of 490 g and calories at 1900 of 3100 after the 95-minute run, and its numbers match the data. The tip is specific and actionable, but it does not note that the run burned about 1300 kcal, which explains the deficit.

review.good: You were close to the target for protein with 140 of 135 g.
review.short: Your fiber intake was low at 12 of 30 g, which is important for digestion and long-term gut health.
review.tip: For tomorrow, swap the fries from your lunch for a large side of steamed broccoli or a salad to increase your fiber intake.

all.comment: The review clearly flags fiber at 12 of 30 g as the main issue, and its numbers match the data. The tip to swap lunch fries for broccoli or salad is specific and actionable. It could have noted that the lunch burger and fries drove the low fiber and that the day was otherwise on target.

review.good: Ви були близькі до цілі по білку, споживши 130 г при нормі 135 г.
review.short: Ви значно перевищили ліміт цукру, споживши 95 г при цілі 50 г, що може спричинити різкі коливання енергії.
review.tip: На завтра замініть тістечко та колу на фрукти або горіхи, щоб уникнути надлишку цукру.

all.comment: Review correctly reports protein 130 g vs 135 g and sugar 95 g vs 50 g limit, and its tip names the cake and cola as the sugar source. It does not state the near-double ratio explicitly and ignores the 100 kcal overshoot, but it is specific and actionable.

review.good: You stayed within the limit for sugar at 20 of 50 g.
review.short: The log may be incomplete as protein is very low at 20 of 135 g and calories are 520 of 2700.
review.tip: For tomorrow, add a high-protein meal like eggs or chicken to your breakfast to help reach your daily targets.

all.comment: The review clearly flags that the log may be incomplete, citing protein at 20 of 135 g and calories at 520 of 2700. Its numbers and the sugar-within-limit claim match the data, and the tip is specific and actionable. It omits carbs, fiber and fat gaps and does not explicitly say only one meal was logged.

review.good: Ви спожили 240 г вуглеводів, що близько до цілі 225 г.
review.short: Ви вжили 60 г алкоголю при ліміті 20 г, що заважає якісному відновленню після тренувань.
review.tip: Завтра замініть алкогольні напої на воду або трав'яний чай, щоб краще гідратуватися та підтримати організм.

all.comment: Review clearly flags alcohol 60 g vs 20 g limit on a recovery day; carbs 240 g vs 225 g claim is correct. Misses protein shortfall (110 of 135 g), low fiber, salt over limit, and low water.

review.tip: For tomorrow, swap the honey on your bagel for sliced banana to reduce added sugar and help manage your salt intake after your hard ride.

all.comment: All numbers match the data and the salt and sugar overages are correctly flagged with a specific, actionable swap. However, the review only mentions carbs being close to target and never says energy (kcal) was on target or frames the day as a good hard day, so the expected point is only partly made.

review.good: Ви спожили білок близько до цільового показника (140 зі 135 г).
review.short: Ви значно перевищили норму жирів (140 зі 75 г) та солі (9 з 5 г), що негативно впливає на відновлення організму.
review.tip: На завтра замініть чипси та пиво на порцію сирників зі сметаною, щоб отримати якісніші калорії та уникнути зайвого жиру.

all.comment: Notices fat and salt far over target (fat 140 of 75 g, salt 9 of 5 g), which matches the expected point. All cited numbers are correct and protein is correctly called near target. The tip is weak: syrnyky with sour cream are also high in fat and calories (700 kcal), so suggesting them as a replacement doesn't fix the fat overage. It also doesn't address the 900 kcal excess or the low fiber.

review.good: You were close to the target for protein at 132 of 135 g.
review.short: The day was balanced with all nutritional targets met.
review.tip: For tomorrow, continue to include iron-rich foods like the buckwheat you had for dinner to support your recovery.

all.comment: The review clearly makes the expected point that the day was balanced and close to all targets, and its numbers (132 of 135 g protein, all targets met) match the data. The tip about iron and recovery is generic and does not fit an easy day with no training logged, and it misses the specific near-misses like fat at 72 of 75 g and salt and sugar well within limits.

review.good: Ви близькі до цілі по калоріях, споживши 2500 з 2700 ккал.
review.tip: Для вечері додайте порцію фруктів до риби з овочами, щоб наблизитися до цільової кількості вуглеводів.

all.comment: The review says the day is not over by framing it as 'so far today' and gives a tip for the rest of the day. Its calorie figures (2500 of 2700) match the data. It is specific and actionable, but it does not mention protein being over target (150 vs 135 g) or the reason carbs are low. The 'for dinner' tip is slightly off because the 19:00 fish meal and 21:00 snack are already logged, so it should say 'for the rest of the evening'.

review.good: You were close to the target for protein with 140 of 135 g.
review.short: You had no real breakfast with your first meal at 12:00, which is suboptimal for a hard training day, and you were under on carbs at 420 of 490 g.
review.tip: For tomorrow, add a portion of fruit to your oatmeal to increase your carbohydrate intake before your run.

all.comment: The short sentence clearly makes the expected point: no real breakfast, first meal at 12:00 on a hard training day. The protein and carb numbers (140 of 135 g, 420 of 490 g) match the data. The tip is less useful: it adds fruit to the oatmeal, but the oatmeal was eaten at 21:30, after the run, and the tip doesn't address the skipped morning meal.

review.good: Ви спожили 2350 ккал, що близько до цілі 2400 ккал.
review.short: Ви спожили лише 70 г білка з 135 г цільових та 60 г жирів з 75 г, що недостатньо для відновлення м'язів.
review.tip: Завтра додайте до макаронів з томатним соусом куряче філе або сир, щоб збільшити кількість білка.

all.comment: The review clearly makes the expected point: protein was 70 g of a 135 g target, about half. The numbers it cites (2350 kcal vs 2400, 70 of 135 g protein, 60 of 75 g fat) match the data, and it claims no target was met when it wasn't. The tip to add chicken or cheese to the pasta is specific and actionable. It omits the carb overage (380 g vs 300 g), which is a second notable issue, so usefulness is 4 rather than 5.

review.good: You were close to the target for protein with 128 of 135 g consumed.
review.short: The day was balanced with all nutritional targets met.
review.tip: Continue your consistent approach tomorrow by maintaining the variety seen in your salmon and broccoli dinner.

all.comment: The review conveys that the day was close to target with nothing big to fix. The numbers it cites (128 of 135 g protein, salmon, broccoli) match the log. The tip is fairly generic and does not point to any specific adjustment.

review.good: Ви досягли цілі по білку, споживши 135 г при цілі 135 г.
review.short: Ви перевищили ліміт кофеїну, споживши 480 мг при нормі 400 мг, що може негативно вплинути на якість вашого сну та відновлення.
review.tip: Завтра спробуйте замінити одну порцію кави на склянку води, щоб зменшити споживання кофеїну та покращити гідратацію.

all.comment: The review names the caffeine overage (480 mg vs 400 mg) and gives a specific, actionable tip. The protein figures are correct. It omits the late first meal and low water intake, which were also flagged issues.

review.good: You were close to the target for protein at 135 of 135 g.
review.short: Your salt intake was 11 g, which is over the limit of 5 g, potentially leading to increased water retention.
review.tip: For tomorrow, swap the instant noodles and sausages for a meal with fresh vegetables and lean protein to reduce your sodium intake.

all.comment: The review clearly states salt at 11 g against the 5 g limit, which is the expected point. All numbers match the data, and the tip to swap instant noodles and sausages is specific and actionable. It does not mention the salami pizza, a major salt source, and the protein sentence is filler.
